basics.description: Deploy Azure SRE Agent with the FinOps toolkit recipe for FinOps hub analysis, capacity monitoring, scheduled tasks, and specialist agents.

basics.name: resourceGroupName
basics.label: Agent resource group
basics.toolTip: Resource group that will contain the Azure SRE Agent, monitoring resources, and deployment script identity.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid Azure resource group name.

basics.name: agentName
basics.label: Agent name
basics.toolTip: Name of the Azure SRE Agent resource.

constraints.validationMessage: Name must be 3-63 characters and can contain letters, numbers, and hyphens. The first and last characters must be alphanumeric.

elements.name: finopsHubKustoConnectorUri
elements.label: FinOps hub Kusto URI
elements.toolTip: Optional database-qualified Azure Data Explorer URI for the FinOps hub. Example: https://cluster.region.kusto.windows.net/Hub

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a database-qualified Kusto URI such as https://cluster.region.kusto.windows.net/Hub, or leave blank.

elements.name: finopsHubKustoClusterResourceId
elements.label: FinOps hub Kusto cluster resource ID
elements.toolTip: Optional Azure Data Explorer cluster resource ID. Provide this to assign the agent managed identity AllDatabasesViewer on the cluster.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid Microsoft.Kusto/clusters resource ID, or leave blank.

elements.name: targetResourceGroups
elements.label: Additional target resource groups
elements.toolTip: Optional comma-separated resource group names the agent can observe or act on. The agent resource group is always included.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a comma-separated list of resource group names without blank entries or trailing commas.

elements.name: accessLevel
elements.label: Access level
elements.toolTip: Low grants read-only monitoring roles (recommended for reporting and analysis). High adds Contributor on target resource groups for autonomous remediation workflows.

elements.name: actionMode
elements.label: Action mode
elements.toolTip: Review requires approval before write actions. Autonomous lets the agent run enabled actions within its assigned access.

elements.name: enableSubscriptionReaderRole
elements.label: Grant subscription Reader to the agent
elements.toolTip: Optional — required only for subscription-wide ARM-backed reports; otherwise scope reads via target resource groups.
